decision: Original InitWindowMsgTable, InitMessageTables and their message arrays are retained. The actual process table is initialized by wow_default_message_bindings.c; gSharedInfo and SharedAlloc bind that storage. szEDITCLASS already has an external definition in the linked original client/dlgbegin.c. WRAPPFN expansion requires private PWND plus kernel procedures. GDI wrappers require Gre functions and tmSysFont; the production edit provider resolves GdiGetCharDimensions. Shared-section mapping and thread startup require kernel section, ERESOURCE and W32THREAD owners. No additional complete callable unit recovered.
